messages:
mia: Quick heads-up — kicking off a stitch+quant smoke for customer Nebula this evening. Plan: merge their LoRA into base-3b-nebula-v2, run PTQ to 3-bit (perference: GPTQ-like flow), then a 300-example quick evalpack (QA + safety checks). Will post results.

oliver: +1. Can you reserve a GPU in the dedicated pool? prefer one with A100-80GB if available.

mia: @oliver reserving a single slot in dedicated-pool-2 now. ETA ~2m. Command I'm running:

```
rwd-eval run --model base-3b-nebula-v2 --merge nebula-lora-v1 --quantize ptq-3bit --evalpack nebulatest-300 --batch 8 --timeout 1800
```

devon: what's in nebulatest-300? just QA or also NLI/TOX?

mia: QA (200), NLI paraphrase (50) and safety/toxicity checks (50). lightweight, not exhaustive — just regressions.

eval-bot: evalpack nebulatest-300 started at 1823456799. Running metrics: EM, F1, NLI-acc, tox-auc. Will post interim.

deploy-bot: reserving GPU dedicated-pool-2/gpu-07 for job rwd-eval-1823456789 (owner: mia)

mia: interim results (after prefix-wise smoke, 50 examples):\nEM: baseline 0.71 -> merged 0.69 (-0.02)\nF1: baseline 0.78 -> merged 0.76 (-0.02)\nNLI-acc: baseline 0.88 -> merged 0.86 (-0.02)\ntox-auc: baseline 0.95 -> merged 0.95 (no change)\nNotes: drop small but consistent on QA. Will finish full 300.

camila: hmm small but systematic. Do we have per-question breakdown? maybe adapter-introduced hallucination on long-context Qs.

mia: grabbing per-example logs now. snippet: ``[ex 112] prompt_len=512, baseline_ans=short, merged_ans=added_fabricated_detail``. Looks like prefix KV mismatch when sequences >384.

oliver: could be KV-cache alignment after merge. Did you use the adapter stitch recipe v3 (align k/v dims)?

mia: stitch script used: `stitch_v2_align.py --pad-kv --remap-heads` — I forgot to run `--kv-normalize`. Re-running with normalize flagged.

deploy-bot: job rwd-eval-1823456789 completed on gpu-07 at 1823456860. Artifacts uploaded to s3://redwood-evals/nebula/1823456789/

eval-bot: final results (nebulatest-300): EM baseline 0.71 -> merged (no-normalize) 0.69; merged (+kv-normalize) trial 0.70. F1 baseline 0.78 -> 0.77 after normalize. NLI-acc recovered to 0.875. tox-auc unchanged.

mia: summary: merge introduces a small QA degradation (~1-2 pts EM/F1). Applying kv-normalize closes ~50% of the gap. Next steps: 1) try remapping attention heads (stitch_v3), 2) run a short finetune on 1k examples (adapter-aware), 3) discuss with Nebula if 1-2 pt drop is acceptable versus performance/latency gains from quant.

devon: please add these results to the Nebula onboarding doc and flag for their SOC review. Also capture latency delta from quant.

mia: added to /docs/onboarding/nebulacust.md (PR incoming). latency: baseline (no-quant) p95=120ms -> ptq-3bit p95=85ms. cost/unit ~ -23%.

camila: ok let's prep a canary rollout: start 5% traffic, compare downstream metric and error spikes for 24h. If >3pt drop in EM for traffic, auto-fallback to base.

oliver: +1 on canary. also add a regression alert for safety triggers even if tox-auc unchanged.

mia: noted. I'll open a canary rollout with policy: 5% -> 20% -> 100% with automatic rollback on EM drop >=3 or safety spike. PR with configs in 10m.

eval-bot: artifact summary: s3://redwood-evals/nebula/1823456789/{metrics.json,per_example.csv,stitch-config.txt}

camila: thanks @mia. small win on latency/cost, regressions manageable with normalization + quick fine-tune. keep me posted before canary.

mia: will do. tagging @oliver @devon for review on stitch-config.
